abstract: 对 Easy Essay 学术论文阅读分析工具进行全面 UI 重设计，以 Apple 设计语言和红点奖级别为标准，在保留全部 8 个页面和 70 余个组件的功能接口不变的前提下，重新构建全局导航、主题系统、排版体系、空间节奏和视觉语言。采用 Inter 字族的 SF Pro 近似排版、frosted glass 半透明层次、非对称空间构图和 seed token 色彩架构，从根本上区别于同质化 SaaS 模板。用户应重点审查：1) 新导航结构是否符合工作流习惯；2) 全新主题色彩方案是否满足学术阅读场景的舒适度需求。

brief.type: academic paper reading and analysis tool
brief.style_constraints: Apple design language, Red Dot Award quality, anti-homogenization, preserve all existing API interfaces
brief.businessGoal: Redesign the entire UI of Easy Essay to achieve Apple-level design quality while preserving all existing functionality and API interfaces. The redesign should create a unique visual identity that avoids the homogeneous SaaS dashboard aesthetic.

scope.components: All 70+ components to be restyled with new design tokens while preserving props interfaces

output.fontStack: Inter Variable (primary), Inter Tight (display headings), JetBrains Mono (code)

designDirection.philosophy: Scholarly Precision meets Apple Craft - an editorial reading environment that feels like a premium research instrument, not a SaaS dashboard

visualStrategy.navigation: Replace top navbar with a collapsible left rail navigation (macOS Finder sidebar pattern) - more scalable and distinctive than the typical top-nav SaaS layout
visualStrategy.surfaceLanguage: Three-layer depth system: base canvas, frosted glass panels (backdrop-filter: blur), and elevated surfaces. Use luminance stepping instead of shadows for dark themes.
visualStrategy.cardsAndContainers: Remove standard card-with-border pattern. Use surface-lifting (subtle bg tint + hairline border at 0.06 opacity) with generous internal padding (20-28px). No colored left-border accent cards.
visualStrategy.typography: Inter Variable with font-feature-settings 'cv01' 'ss03'. Display sizes use aggressive negative tracking (-1.2px at 56px). Weight ladder: 400 (body), 500 (UI/labels), 600 (headings). Never use weight 700.
visualStrategy.motionAndInteraction: Spring-based transitions (cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)). Panels slide with 200ms ease-out. Focus rings use accent color at 0.3 opacity with 4px spread. Hover states use subtle background luminance shift, never color changes.
antiHomogenization: Use frosted glass toolbar floating over content (not fixed bar)
Asymmetric grid layouts - avoid centered max-w-Nxl symmetry
Status indicators as subtle text tints, not colored dots/badges
Knowledge graph uses force-directed layout with organic node sizes
Reader page has floating action capsules instead of standard toolbar
Homepage uses editorial magazine-style composition, not hero+cards

seedTokens.description: All colors derive from 6 seed tokens via CSS color-mix() and relative color syntax

colorArchitecture.themeStrategy: Seed-based theme system with Light and Dark presets. Each preset patches the same 6 seed tokens; all derived colors compute via CSS. No hardcoded hex values outside :root.
colorArchitecture.accentPhilosophy: Accent color used max 2 times per viewport. Primary accent is a warm sapphire (#2563eb) for Light, a luminous cerulean (#60a5fa) for Dark. Never use default Tailwind indigo.

skill.title: dashboard
skill.rationale: mode matches prototype; platform: desktop; design intelligence favors dashboard/data workflow

styleReference.rationale: Apple as primary design language foundation; Linear for dark-mode-first precision and developer tool UX; Stripe for polished data presentation

requiredReads.reason: Dark mode and developer tool UX inspiration

artifacts.purpose: Global stylesheet: new seed token system, typography rules, anti-homogenization base styles, scrollbar refinement, focus ring system, frosted glass utilities
requirements: Replace existing CSS variable system with seed-based 6-token architecture
Add Inter Variable font with font-feature-settings 'cv01' 'ss03'
Define Light and Dark theme via data-theme attribute with seed token patches
Add frosted glass utility classes (.glass-panel, .glass-toolbar)
New scrollbar styling (6px width, minimal thumb)
Focus ring system using accent at 0.3 opacity
Spring transition utility class (.spring-transition)
Preserve all existing [data-theme] override selectors but update values
Remove default Tailwind indigo usage

artifacts.purpose: Theme system: new seed-based color architecture with Light/Dark presets replacing the existing 3-theme system
requirements: Refactor ThemeColors to use 6 seed tokens + derived colors via buildCssVars
Light preset: warm white canvas (#fafaf9) with sapphire accent (#2563eb)
Dark preset: deep graphite (#0c0c0e) with cerulean accent (#60a5fa)
All derived colors (accent-subtle, status colors, code colors) computed from seeds
Preserve Theme/ThemeColors interface shape for backward compatibility
Add isDarkTheme detection using seed-bg luminance
Apply data-mode attribute for code highlight theme switching

artifacts.purpose: Global layout: replace top navbar with collapsible left rail navigation + main content area with floating toolbar pattern
requirements: Replace horizontal navbar with a 64px-wide left rail (expandable to 240px) using macOS Finder sidebar pattern
Rail contains: logo mark, navigation items (with icons), theme toggle, settings gear
Navigation items use icon + label when expanded, icon-only when collapsed
Active state: subtle background fill with accent at 0.08 opacity, no colored text
Secondary navigation (paper tabs, workspace tabs) becomes a floating pill toolbar above content
Content area uses full remaining width with generous padding (32px horizontal)
Preserve all existing nav guard logic (unsaved config dialog)
Preserve keyboard shortcuts integration
Add subtle backdrop-filter blur on rail for depth

artifacts.purpose: Paper list sidebar: refined visual treatment with better typography hierarchy and interaction feedback
requirements: Remove colored status dots; use subtle text-based status indicators
Active paper: gentle surface lift (bg at 0.04 opacity) with 3px accent bar, not 2px
Search input: borderless with frosted glass background
Paper items: 16px padding, 2-line title with tight leading, venue/year in single muted line
Delete button: fade-in on hover with smooth transition
Add subtle section headers when papers grouped by status

artifacts.purpose: Homepage: editorial magazine-style composition replacing standard hero + card grid layout
requirements: Replace centered hero with asymmetric editorial layout: left-aligned wordmark + right-side illustration
Upload zone as a full-width drop area with frosted glass surface and subtle dashed border
Recent papers as a horizontal scrolling row (not 3-column grid) with larger, more detailed cards
Recent workspaces as a compact list section below papers
Use display typography (48-56px, weight 600, -1.2px tracking) for page title
Generous vertical rhythm: 80px section spacing
Status indicators as subtle text tints, not colored dots

artifacts.purpose: Paper reader: floating action capsules, refined three-panel layout with better depth hierarchy
requirements: Replace fixed toolbar with floating capsule action bar (backdrop-filter blur, rounded-full)
Sidebar uses refined Sidebar component
PDF viewer area: no visible border, content flows edge-to-edge within its panel
Analysis panel: refined tab bar with pill-shaped active indicator (not underline)
Drag handle: 2px wide with hover glow effect
Focus mode exit: refined floating button with glass morphism
Preserve all drag-to-resize logic and panel open/close functionality

artifacts.purpose: Library page: refined list view with better information density and search UX
requirements: Page title: display typography (40px, weight 600)
Search bar: full-width frosted glass input with magnifier icon, no border
Paper rows: generous padding (16px vertical), refined status badges as subtle text
Filter controls: compact pill-shaped selectors
Expanded papers section: refined accordion with frosted glass header
Reindex button: ghost button with icon, no colored accent

artifacts.purpose: Workspace list: card-based layout with refined depth and typography
requirements: Page title and create input in an asymmetric header (title left, input right)
Workspace cards: surface-lifted containers with 20px internal padding
Hover: subtle scale(1.01) + shadow increase
Empty state: refined illustration placeholder with muted text
Delete button: text-only, appears on hover with smooth fade

artifacts.purpose: Workspace detail: refined paper management interface with clear visual hierarchy
requirements: Back link: subtle ghost link with chevron, no colored accent
Title: editable inline with smooth transition to input
Deep Research CTA: refined card with subtle gradient border (not bold colored border)
Paper cards: surface-lifted with refined status and action layout
Discovered papers section: dashed border containers with batch action toolbar
Preserve all existing functionality (add, remove, promote, batch operations)

artifacts.purpose: Research page: refined knowledge graph interface with better spatial composition
requirements: Control panel: compact floating toolbar with pill-shaped controls
Graph canvas: full-bleed within its container, no visible border
Edge filter: refined pill toggle group
RAG query box: frosted glass side panel with refined input styling
Progress panel: minimal inline progress with text-based status
Node/Edge detail drawers: refined slide-in panels with glass header
Preserve all graph interaction and research stream functionality

artifacts.purpose: Settings page: refined form layout with better section grouping and visual hierarchy
requirements: Page title: display typography (40px, weight 600)
Config warning: refined alert with subtle background, no harsh red border
Section cards: surface-lifted containers with 24px padding
Save button: refined primary action with accent fill and pill shape
Success indicator: subtle text animation, not green text flash
Preserve all existing config sections and save logic

artifacts.purpose: Code analysis page: refined three-panel code browsing interface
requirements: File browser: refined tree with better indentation and folder icons
Code viewer: preserve existing highlight.js integration, refine container styling
Analysis panel: refined card sections with better typography
Toolbar: compact ghost actions in a subtle top bar
Drag handles: refined with hover accent glow
Preserve all drag-to-resize and SSE analysis functionality

artifacts.purpose: Toast notifications: refined glass-morphism notification cards
requirements: Glass-morphism background with backdrop-filter blur
Subtle left accent bar (3px, status-colored)
Refined typography: 14px body, 12px dismiss
Slide-in animation from bottom-right with spring easing
Auto-dismiss with subtle progress indicator

artifacts.purpose: Confirmation dialog: refined modal with glass backdrop and clear action hierarchy
requirements: Backdrop: dark overlay with backdrop-filter blur(8px)
Dialog: surface-lifted container with 24px padding and 16px radius
Actions: primary (accent fill pill) + secondary (ghost button)
Preserve all existing open/confirm/cancel props interface

artifacts.purpose: Analysis panel: refined tab system and content presentation
requirements: Tab bar: pill-shaped active indicator (not underline), refined typography
Content area: 28px padding with generous vertical rhythm
Idle state: refined empty state with subtle icon and clear CTA
Loading state: refined progress with text-based status, not spinner-only
Reanalyze: refined confirmation dialog
Preserve all tab components and keyboard shortcut (1-7) functionality

artifacts.purpose: Upload zone: refined drag-and-drop area with frosted glass aesthetic
requirements: Full-width drop area with frosted glass surface
Subtle dashed border that glows on drag-over
Progress indicator: refined linear progress bar
Typography: clear hierarchy between instruction and status text

artifacts.purpose: Theme hook: update to work with new seed-based theme system
requirements: Preserve hook interface (returns current theme and setter)
Update internal logic to use new seed token application
Maintain localStorage persistence for theme preference

artifacts.purpose: Theme provider: update to apply new seed-based CSS variables
requirements: Apply seed tokens via CSS custom properties
Set data-theme and data-mode attributes
Preserve ThemeProvider component interface

artifacts.purpose: Tailwind config: align with new design token system, remove unused dark theme colors
requirements: Remove custom dark color palette (no longer needed with seed tokens)
Add fontFamily configuration for Inter Variable
Preserve @tailwindcss/typography plugin
Add custom transition-timing-function for spring easing

artifacts.purpose: HTML entry: update theme initialization script for new seed token system
requirements: Update inline script to apply seed tokens instead of old CSS variables
Add Inter Variable font preconnect/preload
Preserve flash-of-unstyled-content prevention

antiAiSlop: No default Tailwind indigo (#6366f1, #4f46e5, etc.) anywhere
No emoji as feature icons in headings or buttons
No two-stop purple-blue gradients on hero sections
No rounded card with colored left-border accent pattern
No invented metrics or filler copy
var(--accent) used max 2 times per viewport
typography: Inter Variable with font-feature-settings 'cv01' 'ss03' on all text
Display sizes use negative tracking (-1.2px at 56px)
Line-height: 1.00 for display, 1.50 for body, 1.60 for small text
color: All colors derive from 6 seed tokens
No hardcoded hex values in component files
Accent used max 2 times per viewport
Status colors derived from seed-muted with hue rotation
depth: Three-layer system: base/surface/elevated via luminance stepping
Borders at 0.06 opacity, not solid colors
Shadows only for Level 4+ elevation (dropdowns, modals)

screens.label: 工作区详情

risks.risk: Left rail navigation may feel unfamiliar to existing users accustomed to top nav
risks.mitigation: Rail starts in collapsed (icon-only) mode to minimize spatial change; users can expand when ready

risks.risk: Replacing 3-theme system with 2-theme seed system reduces theme variety
risks.mitigation: Seed architecture allows easy addition of creative presets (Editorial, Calm, etc.) as future iterations

risks.risk: Frosted glass effects (backdrop-filter) may impact performance on older hardware
risks.mitigation: Provide fallback solid backgrounds via @supports; limit blur usage to key UI elements
